label: Maliit na bayan / rural na barangay
text: Attend your next barangay assembly. Ask to see the posted budget. Bring one neighbor.
text_en: Attend your next barangay assembly. Ask to see the posted budget. Bring one neighbor.

label: Barangay sa lungsod
text: Find your barangay's posted budget (barangay hall wall or website). Ask one question about it at the next assembly.
text_en: Find your barangay's posted budget (barangay hall wall or website). Ask one question about it at the next assembly.

label: Komunidad ng paaralan
text: Ask your school's PTA or SGC to post the budget. Offer to help make it readable.
text_en: Ask your school's PTA or SGC to post the budget. Offer to help make it readable.

label: Heneral
text: Ask one local official one question about a local project. Write down the answer. Share it with one neighbor.
text_en: Ask one local official one question about a local project. Write down the answer. Share it with one neighbor.
